impact.text: The protocol's emergency pause mechanism fails to provide complete protection, undermining its primary safety purpose

precondition_sources.text: Protocol administrators have called deactivateProtocol() to pause trading operations, so clearingHouse.active is false.
Trading operations such as placeOrder and liquidate properly revert with ProtocolNotActive error while the protocol is paused.

intent_sources.text: When the protocol is inactive (paused), deposit and withdrawal operations must be blocked, consistent with the onlyActiveProtocol protection applied to trading functions.
